about: Security findings accepted for now (R5.17): each with its reason and the date after which it fails the security gate again. Kept with the code and reviewed like it; one installation may add its own in persist/security-accepted.json.

accepted.reason: Content-Security-Policy style-src 'unsafe-inline' (ZAP medium, 14 Nov 2026): the screens, draw.io and Swagger set styles on elements; scripts stay strict (D672). To be looked at again by the date.

Pillow inside the Reports (Superset 6.1.0) image: the fix (Pillow 13) needs Python 3.11 and the image is Python 3.10, so it cannot be installed (clean rebuild, 15 Nov 2026). Superset uses Pillow only for thumbnails and screenshots, both off here. To clear when Superset is upgraded; looked at again in the version review (R5.23, D699).
SQL built from text (bandit B608): accepted for good by the owner as the way EA Explorer builds its queries. Not a finding to fix.
accepted.by: owner, 19 Nov 2026, 18:24: "SQL built from text is ok with what we want to do, so ignore them all" (D800)
